# Metro Parking

> Guest parking registration for your community, in seconds.

<!-- seo-agent:start -->
## Guides

### Active Permits and Usage Tab

- [How do I cancel a guest parking permit?](https://nithinrgaddam.github.io/metro-parking/guides/active-permits-and-usage-tab/cancel-guest-parking-permit/): Plans changed? Cancel a guest parking permit from the Usage tab list, check its status badge, and know who to contact if something looks off.
- [What do active, upcoming and expired parking permits mean?](https://nithinrgaddam.github.io/metro-parking/guides/active-permits-and-usage-tab/permit-status-active-upcoming-expired/): Active means a permit is in force now, upcoming means it starts later, expired means it has ended. See how to read all guest parking at a glance.

### Expiration Reminders and Calendar Alarms

- [How do I get a reminder before guest parking expires?](https://nithinrgaddam.github.io/metro-parking/guides/expiration-reminders-and-calendar-alarms/reminder-before-guest-parking-expires/): Three ways to get a reminder before guest parking expires: a phone timer, a calendar alarm, or Metro Parking Pro reminders. Plus where each one falls short.
- [Should I use a calendar alarm for parking expiration?](https://nithinrgaddam.github.io/metro-parking/guides/expiration-reminders-and-calendar-alarms/calendar-alarm-for-parking-expiration/): Compare a heads-up notification with an alarm at the exact expiration time for guest parking permits, and pick the style that suits you.

### Monthly Hours Tracking

- [How do I track guest parking hours each month?](https://nithinrgaddam.github.io/metro-parking/guides/monthly-hours-tracking/track-guest-parking-hours-monthly/): Add up guest parking hours per vehicle each month and compare them with your community's limit. Here is a simple method and where the app helps.
- [How do I avoid going over my guest parking hour limit?](https://nithinrgaddam.github.io/metro-parking/guides/monthly-hours-tracking/avoid-going-over-guest-parking-hour-limit/): Plan guest visits around a monthly parking hour cap by tracking hours per vehicle, and know what Metro Parking shows and what it leaves to you.

### Multiple Vehicles

- [How do I handle guest parking for family who visit often?](https://nithinrgaddam.github.io/metro-parking/guides/multiple-vehicles/guest-parking-for-frequent-family-visitors/): Keep a regular visitor's plate saved with a nickname in Metro Parking, then pick it at registration so repeat visits take one tap.

### One-Tap Guest Registration

- [Where do I find my guest parking passcode?](https://nithinrgaddam.github.io/metro-parking/guides/one-tap-guest-registration/find-guest-parking-passcode/): Your guest parking passcode comes from your property management or leasing office. Here is what to ask them for before you set up guest registration.
- [How do I register a guest vehicle with a parking passcode?](https://nithinrgaddam.github.io/metro-parking/guides/one-tap-guest-registration/register-guest-vehicle-parking-passcode/): Step-by-step: get your passcode, choose your unit, add the guest's plate and pick a duration. A first-timer's guide to registering guest parking.

### Sign In and Account Setup

- [How do I delete my account in a parking app?](https://nithinrgaddam.github.io/metro-parking/guides/sign-in-and-account-setup/delete-metro-parking-account/): Delete Account in Metro Parking Settings erases your vehicles, contact details, passcode and parking history from your iPhone and signs you out.
- [Can I use a parking app without a password?](https://nithinrgaddam.github.io/metro-parking/guides/sign-in-and-account-setup/parking-app-without-a-password/): Yes. Metro Parking uses Sign in with Apple only, so there is no password to create and no email to verify. Here is the one-time setup that follows.
